attribution: Tree canopy: Meta & World Resources Institute, High Resolution Canopy Height Maps (2024), CC BY 4.0
note: 树的位置和高度来自 1 米分辨率卫星树冠高度数据；species 是按位置推测的建议（湖岸→垂柳，岛与北岸土山的高树→松柏，其余→阔叶），不是实测树种。shrubs 是 0.8–3.5 米的低矮植被，可作为灌木丛/躲藏区。

canopyRaster.encoding: grayscale PNG, pixel value = canopy height in metres (0 = no vegetation)
canopyRaster.note: row 0 is the north edge (rowsY[0]); local x/y use the same origin as campus.json; pixel size about 0.92 m
